summary: Social Queue MVP (Generate & Queue path C) fully verified end-to-end. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass; Playwright e2e covers register → create org → navigate to /app/org/:id/social → compose via LLM → verify defaults (twitter+linkedin pre-selected, instagram off) → verify deep-link href → edit/schedule auto-flips draft→queued → mark posted → delete → chat ‘Queue for social’ pill alongside existing ‘Continue privately’ fork pill + 'Added to Social Queue' toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3586 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold. Social router was correctly factored out into /app/backend/social_posts.py (good pattern); consider applying the same factoring to the conv/messages & org blocks as server.py keeps growing.

social_posts.py _draft_via_agent: the JSON regex r'\[\s*\{.*?\}\s*\]' is non-greedy and will truncate multi-post arrays whose last object contains a nested '}' before the closing ']' (e.g. hashtag objects). Consider a more tolerant JSON extractor (brace-counting or json5) to avoid silently dropping drafts.
SocialPage.js PLATFORMS.threads.accent and tiktok.accent are '#fff' — invisible on the light theme. Pills look fine on dark theme only. Swap to brand colours (#000 for Threads, #FE2C55 for TikTok).

SocialPage.js: clicking an '<a target="_blank"' deep-link also fires copyText() which writes to the clipboard *on every click* with no opt-out. Make the copy explicit (separate button or toast-confirm) so power users don’t get surprise clipboard overwrites.

Promote-due-drafts scheduler helper sets ready_at but nothing surfaces ‘ready’ status in the UI — the Scheduled tab only filters by status='queued'. Either promote to status='ready' with a dedicated tab, or drop the helper until phase 2.
test_credentials: Auto-registered ephemeral users each run via POST /api/auth/register (TEST_ prefix). No standing admin.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test run registers a fresh user + creates a TEST_ org; social posts tagged with TEST_ text so cleanup by prefix is trivial.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_social_posts.py uses _load_backend_url() that falls back to /app/frontend/.env so it works inside pytest without env exports. Org is NOT auto-created on register; fixture posts to /api/orgs first (bare org, no website to avoid slow scrape). Chat test pulls agents via /api/teams/{team_id}/agents, NOT /api/agents (the latter does not exist). All 11 platforms in SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS verified via frontend PLATFORMS map; only instagram/tiktok/youtube have no deep-link (render 'Copy for <platform>').
